title: Bonus Exercise Pack - Advanced TRANS-QML Development
description: A comprehensive collection of advanced exercises covering real-world TRANS-QML development patterns

exercises.title: Complete Scientific Application
exercises.description: Build a mini spectroscopy viewer that loads data, displays graphs, and applies basic processing

exercises.title: Threaded Data Processor
exercises.description: Create a multi-threaded data processing pipeline with progress reporting and cancellation

exercises.title: Custom Graph Canvas
exercises.description: Implement a QQuickPaintedItem that renders matplotlib figures with zoom and pan

exercises.title: Advanced Table Model
exercises.description: Build a pandas-backed table model with formulas, statistics, and CSV import/export

exercises.title: Dockable Workspace System
exercises.description: Create a complete workspace with collapsible panels, floating windows, and theme switching

exercises.title: Full Application Backend
exercises.description: Implement a complete AppBackend with project management, preferences, and tool dispatch

exercises.title: Build and Distribution Pipeline
exercises.description: Create a complete build system with Makefile, PyInstaller spec, and JSON logging

exercises.title: Code Quality Analyzer
exercises.description: Build a complete code complexity analyzer with cyclomatic, nesting, and cognitive metrics

exercises.title: Workflow Node System
exercises.description: Implement a visual node-based workflow system with connections and execution

exercises.title: Real-Time Data Visualization
exercises.description: Create a streaming data visualizer that updates in real-time with efficient rendering

mini_challenges.title: Signal Relay
mini_challenges.description: Create a signal that chains through 3 Python objects before reaching QML

mini_challenges.title: Property Computed
mini_challenges.description: Create a read-only property that computes from other properties

mini_challenges.title: Context Menu
mini_challenges.description: Add a context menu to a QML component with Python backend actions

mini_challenges.title: Async File Load
mini_challenges.description: Load a large file without blocking the UI using QThread

mini_challenges.title: Number Formatter
mini_challenges.description: Create a locale-aware number parser supporting European and US formats
